name: travelai-monorepo
description: waytowalk — collaborative trips, traveller discovery and agency workspaces

scripts.build:frontend: npm run build --workspace=frontend && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); if(fs.existsSync('frontend/dist')) { const assets=path.join('backend/public','assets'); fs.rmSync(assets,{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'backend/public', {recursive:true}); }"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.verify: npm run test:backend && npm run build:backend && npm run ui:contrast && npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend && npm run test:key-backup --workspace=frontend && npm run test:auth-policy --workspace=frontend && npm run test:itinerary-truth --workspace=frontend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
